label: late-episode clock (last ~13 trials) at D1, and at D2 after choosing a2
explanation: An episode-end timer. The unit never fires before episode trial ~75; its rate climbs to 13% in trials 80-89 and 38% in trials 90-99, which is also where the value head drops below ~5.2 (94% of the mass falls in the lowest value bin). Inside that late window it fires at D1 (77% of the mass) and at D2 only when the agent chose a2 (in_action == 2). It is essentially silent at GO and at D2 after a1. Using only observed variables, (ep_trial >= 87) & (D1 | D2 after a2) gets dev P 0.63, R 0.83, F1 0.72, mass recall 0.95. Earlier thresholds raise recall but lower precision; value < 5.2 works about equally well. In the example windows activation rises steadily from trial to trial, consistent with a ramp toward episode end. The biggest values come at D2 after a2 leads rarely to S1, and at D1 after a reward; this was checked only from examples. Precision is incomplete: many late D1/D2 steps stay below threshold, mostly early in the late window or in a1-dominant episodes (the a2 and good=S2 lift is about 1.3-1.5x).
